schedule.heading: 2026 Schedule
schedule.subheading: Last Saturday of each month · May through August

kids.title: The Iron Giant
kids.description: A lonely boy befriends a gentle giant robot from outer space and must protect him from a paranoid government agent.

adults.title: The Hudsucker Proxy
adults.description: A naive business-school graduate is installed as president of a manufacturing company as part of a Wall Street stock scam. A Coen Brothers gem.

kids.title: My Neighbor Totoro
kids.description: Two sisters move to the countryside and discover the forest is filled with magnificent, friendly spirits. Shown in English dub.

adults.title: It Follows
adults.description: A slow, relentless supernatural force pursues a young woman through suburban Detroit. Best watched outdoors, in the dark.

kids.title: The Secret of NIMH
kids.description: A widowed field mouse must relocate her family and turns to a mysterious colony of superintelligent rats for help.

adults.title: A Star Is Born
adults.description: A seasoned musician helps a young singer find fame, as his own troubled career begins its final decline.

kids.title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
kids.description: Wallace and Gromit investigate a mysterious beast terrorizing the community's prize-vegetable competition.

adults.title: Waitress
adults.description: A gifted pie-making waitress trapped in a loveless marriage dares to dream of a sweeter life.

howto.heading: How Does It Work?
howto.intro: Everything you need to know before you show up:

rules.title: Double Feature
rules.text: Every night is a double feature. First a kids movie, then a late movie. Before each film we show a short cartoon, and there's a brief intermission between films!

rules.title: FM Radio Audio
rules.text: Just like at the drive-in, audio is transmitted over stereo FM radio. Bring a boom box, walkman, or any FM radio. The frequency will be announced when we start the film!

rules.title: Be Cool
rules.text: If you or your kids are making trouble or hurting people or animals, you'll be asked to leave. End of story.

rules.title: Flashlights Welcome
rules.text: Bring a flashlight for when it gets dark, but please don't shine it during the movie.

rules.title: Kids Play Area
rules.text: We have a swingset and a chicken coop on the property! Kids can play when they need a break from the screen.

rules.title: No Pets
rules.text: No pets allowed. We have cats and chickens on-site that will get upset. Please leave your furry friends at home.

rules.title: Arrive Early
rules.text: Movies begin at dusk. Come earlier to get a good spot on the lawn!

rules.title: Bring Your Own Everything
rules.text: Bring your own blanket, picnic, and drinks. Some alcohol is OK! But don't push it. Water is available from the hose.

rules.title: Facilities
rules.text: If you need to use the bathroom, you're welcome to use ours inside — just be respectful of the house.

rules.title: Chairs Welcome
rules.text: Lawn chairs are welcome! Please set them up in the back half of the seating area so blanket-sitters up front can see.

rules.title: Parking
rules.text: Please park on the street. Do not block the driveway.

rules.title: No Smoking
rules.text: No smoking anywhere on the property, please.

rsvp.heading: Come Join Us!
rsvp.intro: Scott Road Cinema is free and open to the whole neighborhood. RSVP is required so we know how many to expect.
rsvp.note: RSVPing helps us know how many folks to expect, but it's not required. All neighbors are welcome!
